lessons.goal: 核對借閱延期成功與可續借條件。

questions.evidence: Librarian: Please check the loans page again. A renewal is complete only when a new due date is displayed. Books requested by another reader cannot be renewed. If your request failed, the original return date still applies.
questions.explanation: 新到期日出現才算續借成功。
options: A spinning circle.
Clicking the button alone.
Closing the page early.
A new due date on the loans page.
questions.prompt: What shows that a renewal has succeeded?

questions.evidence: Student: The page still shows tomorrow, and there is a message saying another reader is waiting. Librarian: Then please return the book by tomorrow. You may join the waiting list to borrow it again, but that does not extend the current loan.
questions.explanation: 頁面通知已有其他讀者等候。
options: The library has no waiting list.
The student has already returned it.
All renewals are forbidden.
Another reader has requested it.
questions.prompt: Why is this book not renewed?

questions.evidence: Student: I will finish my notes tonight and bring it back before lunch. Librarian: Good. Save the title and page references in your notes so you can find the relevant part later without assuming the book will always remain available.
questions.explanation: 記下頁碼可日後查找，不是延期資格。
options: They help locate relevant material when the book is available again.
They count as a replacement for returning the book.
They automatically extend the loan.
They remove another reader's request.
questions.prompt: Why save page references in personal notes?

questions.evidence: Student: The page still shows tomorrow, and there is a message saying another reader is waiting. Librarian: Then please return the book by tomorrow. You may join the waiting list to borrow it again, but that does not extend the current loan.
questions.explanation: extend current loan 指延長當次借期。
options: Write a shorter title.
Display a spinning circle.
Return a different book.
Make the allowed period longer.

questions.explanation: 續借未成功則照原期限歸還，可另候補。
options: Return by the original deadline and join the list for a future loan if needed.
Keep the book because Renew was clicked.
Treat joining the waiting list as a new due date.
Erase the waiting-reader message before closing.
questions.prompt: Which action follows the librarian's advice?

options: Starting a request differs from having it accepted.
A title reference equals a renewed loan.
Finishing notes cancels a return requirement.
Every displayed date changes when clicked.
questions.prompt: What distinction matters most in the chat?
